protocol.measured_order: baseline,P when (state_index+repetition) is even, else P,baseline
protocol.memory: process RSS sampled separately outside timed searches; no allocation tracing or profiler
protocol.root_dispatch: evaluate_artifact_position; exact_root_solve_threshold=16; exact leaf solve disabled
protocol.seed_contract: 514000 plus cohort order index, shared by baseline and P
protocol.timing: perf_counter_ns around complete evaluate_artifact_position call, including exact-root dispatch

selection: unique nonterminal trajectory states; bucket counts gt32=32, 17to32=16, le16=16; sort by SHA256(seed514-cohort-v1:<state_sha256>:<game_index>:<ply>) then state identity; no outcomes/model outputs
